name: com.videodataapi/mcp-server
title: VideoDataAPI — YouTube Transcript, Subtitles & Comments MCP. Zero-signup x4
description: YouTube Transcript, Subtitles & Comments MCP. Zero-signup x402 USDC ($0.001) on Base or API key.

tools.name: youtube_transcript
tools.description: Extract timed subtitle segments and plain-text transcript for any public YouTube video or Short in any available language.

video_id.description: 11-character YouTube video ID or full youtube.com/watch?v=... / youtu.be/... URL.

lang.description: Preferred 2-letter subtitle language code (e.g. en, es, fr, de, ja). Defaults to en.

tools.name: youtube_video_info
tools.description: Fetch full YouTube video metadata including title, description, view count, like count, duration, publish date, keywords, and channel details.

video_id.description: 11-character YouTube video ID or full YouTube watch/Shorts URL.

tools.name: youtube_comments
tools.description: Extract top or newest video comments with author channel info, like count, reply count, published time, and continuation cursor.

video_id.description: 11-character YouTube video ID or full YouTube URL.

sort_by.description: Comment sort order: top or newest (default top).

token.description: Continuation cursor token returned from a previous page.

tools.name: youtube_search
tools.description: Search YouTube videos, Shorts, channels, or playlists by keyword with type, sort order, and continuation pagination.

sort_by.description: Sort order for search results (default relevance).

token.description: Continuation cursor token for loading the next page.

tools.name: youtube_channel
tools.description: Resolve any YouTube @handle, channel ID (UC...), or vanity URL into subscriber count, video count, description, and avatar.

channel_id.description: Canonical 24-character YouTube channel ID starting with UC.

tools.name: youtube_channel_videos
tools.description: List uploaded long-form videos for a YouTube channel sorted by newest, popular, or oldest.

channel_id.description: Canonical 24-character YouTube channel ID starting with UC.

tools.name: youtube_channel_shorts
tools.description: List uploaded YouTube Shorts for a creator channel sorted by newest or popular.

channel_id.description: Canonical 24-character YouTube channel ID starting with UC.

tools.name: youtube_trending
tools.description: Fetch currently trending YouTube videos by 2-letter ISO country code and category.

geo.description: 2-letter ISO 3166-1 country code such as US, GB, DE, or JP (default US).
